correctness.rationale: An exact affine Markov partition makes the stationary code a four-state chain with rows E,C; explicit conditional uniformity proves Markovness for all histories. Positivity and stationarity of π are algebraically checked. The 2×2 center projection has subunit eigenvalue r; exact symbolic multiplication gives P²=1π+r(P−1π). r vanishes uniquely at p=(a−1)/a, producing P²=1π while P≠1π, hence strict one-dependence. The two-state factor covariance α(1−α)r^n proves absence of any finite-dependence radius otherwise. Universal real-parameter proof is analytic; symbolic identities and 24 rational tests are corroborative.

value.rationale: Natural critical-point partition of a two-map W-family yields an exact unique finite-memory boundary for every a>2 rather than an arbitrary numeric example. It sharply distinguishes strict 1-dependence of the complete four-symbol code, iid center/outer observations and infinite-range nonzero covariances on both sides, with a sign reversal. This resolves a motivated temporal-statistics question for maps previously analyzed for invariant measures and spectral stability.
